full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos: 1 and 4 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the plaint case and stating that suit Plot No.2022 and 2058 are Government khas land while suit Plot No.2040 and 2059 belonged to Mongal Mosar and Prakandi Ruhidas for making cement goodown and keeping construction materials thereon, the suit land including other lands measuring an area 1.69 acre was requisitioned and the tenants thereof were served with notices. Some of the tenants received compensation awarded to them and some of them were tendered. The plaintiffs have no right, title, interest and possession in the suit land and .hence the suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
